rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 4.43 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

Two eligible VU site-bound forest species are recorded beyond 250 m and within 1000 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (nearest 451 m, 2023, unc 8 m; also 2025) and Phellopilus nigrolimitatus (883 m, 2025, unc 5 m). Both list felling-relevant threats such as lack of continuity forest. Rubric hint is MEDIUM.
No kept records inside the polygon or within 250 m. Effort is low (27 records within 1000 m versus county median 66, 24th percentile), so the empty inner rings are weak evidence.
Site-bound NT species at 412-799 m (Lobaria pulmonaria, Chaenotheca gracillima, Crossocalyx hellerianus) are supporting context. They are all beyond 250 m, so the 3-NT-within-250 m rule is not met.

contradictions.claim: Effort is below the county median while threatened site-bound species are recorded within 1000 m. The contradiction is unresolved.

uncertainties: All eligible records are at least 451 m away, so whether the species occur on the notified stand is unknown.
15 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty and may hide nearer records.
Low recording effort limits what the empty inner rings mean.
not_established: Presence or absence of any species within the polygon.
Habitat quality or age of the stand.
Legality of the felling or any causal effect of it on nearby species.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand's habitat against the nearby VU lichen and fungus records. Consider a field inventory before felling begins. A nearby notification, A 40384-2026, shares some of the same records and could be reviewed together.
